question:
elect the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fragile
solution:
The correct answer is: **Delicate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fragile"** means something that is easily broken, damaged, or destroyed. It typically refers to objects or situations that require careful handling. (नाज़ुक)

 
 
• **Example:** The old vase is fragile, so handle it with care.
 

 
• **"Delicate"** refers to something that is fine, subtle, or fragile in structure or nature. It can also imply sensitivity or being easily damaged. (नाजुक)

 
 
• **Example:** The delicate flowers need protection from strong winds.
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym for **'Fragile'** is **'Delicate'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Delicate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Heavy **(भारी): Something that has great weight or is difficult to lift.

 
 
• **Example:** The suitcase was too heavy for me to carry alone.
 

 
• **Shiny **(चमकीला): Something that reflects light or has a bright and glossy appearance.

 
 
• **Example:** The shiny surface of the car made it look brand new.
 

 
• **Strong** (मज़बूत): Having great physical power or being sturdy and resistant to damage.

 
 
• **Example:** The bridge was built strong to withstand heavy traffic.
